d: In this video, Firstpost explains Bentley's plans to launch its first fully electric car, the Torcal, in India in the second half of 2027. The luxury electric SUV is expected to offer a 600-km range and a 113kWh battery. While its estimated ex-showroom price is around ₹4.50 crore, Bentley has not confirmed the figure. The British carmaker will import the vehicle from the UK and has ruled out local manufacturing. We also look at how the India-UK free trade agreement could affect prices and why Bentley is slowing down its all-electric transition.
